name: HMG (Human Menopausal Gonadotropin)
storage: Store at -20 °C, protected from light and moisture.
definition: HMG (Human Menopausal Gonadotropin) (GT) is a recombinant protein supplied as white lyophilized powder. The catalogue lists 1 pack size: 75 iu. The CAS number, full sequence and molecular weight are recorded in the lot-specific certificate of analysis (COA). Purity is stated at ≥99.0% (HPLC) with white lyophilized powder appearance. Each kit contains 10 vials; minimum order quantity is 1 kit. For laboratory research use only; not for human or veterinary use.

faq.question: How is HMG (Human Menopausal Gonadotropin) tested for purity and identity?
faq.answer: Testing for HMG (Human Menopausal Gonadotropin): HPLC purity against ≥99.0% (HPLC), MS confirmation of the intact mass, and a documented identity record (no public CAS entry). Results are reported per lot, not as a catalogue average.

faq.question: How should HMG (Human Menopausal Gonadotropin) be stored?
faq.answer: Hold the sealed 10-vial kit at −20 °C, away from light and humidity. Once reconstituted, aliquot and keep at 2–8 °C; this GT preparation does not tolerate repeated freeze–thaw.

faq.question: What pack sizes are available for HMG (Human Menopausal Gonadotropin)?
faq.answer: HMG (Human Menopausal Gonadotropin) is stocked in 1 pack size (75 IU), 10 vials per kit, MOQ 1 kit. At 1–9 kits the per-kit price is $58.14; 10–49 kits falls to $53.48 (−8%) and 50+ to $49.42 (−15%).
